title: Alphonce Oyugi
text: Alphonce Oyugi is a global early-career health researcher, healthcare innovator, and public health professional passionate about using data, artificial intelligence, and point-of-care technologies to strengthen healthcare systems. He works at the intersection of global health, digital health, health technology, and implementation research, with a focus on improving health outcomes in low- and middle-income countries. He is currently pursuing a Master of Science in Global Health at Duke University.
